To the degree that Sad Roach has a rather positive look at bugs, Bad roach's view on bugs is, well, bad. I am reminded of SCP-006-J here, and think that an inline link from this page to there is a solid way of linking two joke articles with close views on bugs. As such, I am proposing the following edit:

Changing the following:

SCP-724-J is a Periplaneta americana (American cockroach) believed to be the younger brother of SCP-723-J.

To this:

SCP-724-J is a Periplaneta americana (American cockroach) believed to be the younger brother of SCP-723-J.

If anyone has other/better examples that could be used here please leave a comment saying so!

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
The good:
Apparently, D-class can just wander around, poke their heads into interviews, and answer the door for pizza.

The bad:
Almost all of the jokes here feel highly derivative. Both the very first and the very last jokes in this article, the object class and "BAD ROACH NO", are directly taken from Sad Roach, and don't even stand on their own as anything other than references to sad roach.

Unfortunately, that's how most of the jokes turn out. They're either standard site jokes ("seemingly harmless object offhandedly kills a dozen people" is a standout example of this) or less creative rehashes of jokes from Sad Roach. You never commit to giving this thing any actual interesting aspects, and don't even commit to rehashing things from Sad Roach ("SAD ROACH NO" had more buildup because the name was used throughout the article, for example, and the testimonials section here is so short that you wonder why it's in here except to say "see? sad roach did this too!"). Rather than putting the original in a new light, you just put it in the exact same light, but dimmer.

I love Sad Roach (still miffed about that Darkblade match), but this just comes across as the off-brand knockoff. The jokes that are references to Sad Roach come off as far too derivative, and the jokes that aren't references to Sad Roach are far too standard. It needs to put in more work to actually be its own thing before it'll be anything other than "Sad roach but worse".

Total Verdict: Downvote.
